name: stacia-utils
description: Claude Code plugins published from Stacia's stacias-utils repo. Add a plugin here when you add it under plugins/; `summon lint` checks this file stays accurate.

plugins.name: stacia
plugins.description: Stacia's utilities for Claude Code. One umbrella plugin: each utility is a self-contained directory under skills/, invoked as /stacia:<utility>. Registered once by `summon setup`; adding or removing a utility never requires re-registering.
